mask_encoding: row runs [y,x,length], absolute sheet pixel coordinates
scalpDefinition: Fixed anatomical crown underpainting for each oriented g3 head; opaque face mask sits under the hair and uses per-frame RLE. Both face options share the same crown. Baseline head locations are never reflected or rescaled.

production.method: Independent per-direction decomposition of the original g3 8-view sheet, plus manually traced spiky-hair guides and perspective bun placement. Left views use their own source cells and independent guides, never horizontal reflection. South hair2 refined in place with source hair ramp; face2 adds brown skin-shade freckles.
production.headMotion: All six south walking head components keep the same baked per-frame anchors and source motion; no runtime offsets. Standing NE/N/NW whole-cell translations are +1 px y; all others 0.

stageB.method: Exact 5-row reference decomposition with frame-aware braid boundaries; approved own left-view heads and hand-plotted left-view legs, boots, wrists and cape hems. No reflection or rescaling of source pixels.

stageB2.method: B2 native west-view redraw of legs, boots, clean skirt/short hems, continuous torso underpainting, silver sleeves/peach hands and six independently plotted backward cape silhouettes. Original left head layers retained; no reflection.

pendingAcceptance.stageA: Passed by owner and Claude; no changes to its PNGs.
pendingAcceptance.stageB: B1 accepted and integrated in GM 2.19; B2 west motion and artwork pending Claude / owner review.
pendingAcceptance.integration: Claude imports walking assets in GM mode after review.

leftViewEvidence.operation: Independent source-cell decomposition and per-direction path guides; no flip operations.

turn.layout: 6 rows; left 8 cells at native 1x, right same 8 cells at nearest-neighbour 2x.

previews.note: The three stage-A preview files follow the replacement preview list in spec v4.

notes: Hairback2 and hairback3 are intentionally transparent for the short cut and high buns; their full visible hair is in the hair layer.
The original option-1 composite is exact after documented whole-cell y alignment. Source PNGs are unchanged and no horizontal translation, scale or reflection is applied.
Back-facing eyes and mouths are empty for NE, N, NW. Face2 freckles appear only on visible cheeks.
Cape RGBA regions remain unchanged between body options. Full back views naturally conceal the shorts beneath the cape.
All preview comparisons are rendered from the delivered layer files. P3 review images are superseded by the full-A previews.
Stage B adds walking sheets only. Stage A layer images, regions, palette indices and tones are preserved; the existing source lip shade #B04B3A is appended to mouth. Runtime/game files are unchanged.

Left rows use native left art with independently drawn stride poses, not reflected right-facing asymmetric hair or lighting. Exact g3 comparison applies to the five source rows; left foot heights follow the paired source direction.
Walking head roots preserve original offsets; per-frame source hair outlines can deform slightly. No runtime layer offsets are needed.

B2 updates row 6 of body-1/body-2 only; all 14 walking head layers and rows 0–5/7 are byte/pixel identical to B1. Recheck live appearance using the B2 preview; the B1 preview is retained as historical evidence.

walk.hairbackPairing: Use the same option number as hair; 2 and 3 are intentionally transparent.
walk.timing: Keep the existing g3 six-frame walking cadence; this delivery does not change runtime timing.
walk.footRule: Rows 0–4 retain exact source alpha-bottom per frame. Rows 5/6/7 use source rows 3/2/1 foot-height timing respectively, recorded per frame in walkRows. No global y normalization.
walk.headRule: A single baked head anchor is shared by face, eyes, mouth and cap in each frame. Source option 1 retains original per-frame pixel shape; alternate directional head artwork follows that measured anchor without independent layer offsets. Braids retain source tip motion.
walk.regionEncoding: RLE [y,x,length], absolute sheet pixels; groups never overlap. Fixed outline, clothes, boots and whites are not recolored unless explicitly tagged.
walk.referenceEquality: All-one composite in rows 0–4 equals the unscaled source crop, RGBA exact. Each layer row 0 equals A frames 8–13, RGBA exact.

stageA.status: Accepted by owner and Claude before stage B.

walkValidation.headRegistrationMethod: For each face/eye/mouth/hair option and direction, register each nonempty frame against frame 0 over integer shifts -2..2. Compare the minimum-RGBA-difference shift with the shared head-root displacement (ties prefer the expected displacement). Back empty eyes/mouth are separately checked. Source shapes can deform; their residual shape differences are not anchor shifts.
